title: Google\Cloud\Compute\V1\VpnGatewayStatusHighAvailabilityRequirementState
name: VpnGatewayStatusHighAvailabilityRequirementState
description: Describes the high availability requirement state for the VPN connection between this Cloud VPN gateway and a peer gateway.

params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.state
params.description: Indicates the high availability requirement state for the VPN connection. Valid values are CONNECTION_REDUNDANCY_MET, CONNECTION_REDUNDANCY_NOT_MET.

params.name: data.unsatisfied_reason
params.description: Indicates the reason why the VPN connection does not meet the high availability redundancy criteria/requirement. Valid values is INCOMPLETE_TUNNELS_COVERAGE.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Indicates the high availability requirement state for the VPN connection. Valid values are CONNECTION_REDUNDANCY_MET, CONNECTION_REDUNDANCY_NOT_MET.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Indicates the high availability requirement state for the VPN connection. Valid values are CONNECTION_REDUNDANCY_MET, CONNECTION_REDUNDANCY_NOT_MET.

methods.name: getUnsatisfiedReason
methods.description: Indicates the reason why the VPN connection does not meet the high availability redundancy criteria/requirement. Valid values is INCOMPLETE_TUNNELS_COVERAGE.

methods.name: setUnsatisfiedReason
methods.description: Indicates the reason why the VPN connection does not meet the high availability redundancy criteria/requirement. Valid values is INCOMPLETE_TUNNELS_COVERAGE.
